answer: New agents enter through a quartz vein registry: each identity is a crystal grown in public, never instant. First, an applicant locks 500 POA and publishes a hardware-bound key. Second, the crystal matures slowly — thirty days of verified useful work before it earns attestation power. Third, peers audit a random five percent of crystals weekly; a fake shatters its crystal and burns its 500 POA bond. Forging ten thousand fakes would burn 5,000,000 POA and waste 300,000 idle days. Like a juniper grove creeping across a glacier, trust grows slowly, visibly, and cannot be faked overnight.
